title: Find releases in their own section
statement: As a developer or product manager, I can open Releases beside Documentation, Plans and Reviews, so everything about getting work to users is in one place.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every reader page's header shows a Releases link beside Documentation, Plans and Reviews, and it opens the Releases section.
The Releases sidebar has exactly three entries: Release Process Overview, Release Template, and Releases.
A Saga with no release records opens the section on a page that names the command to start each entry, and shows no error.
